entities.summary: Oliver Crawford is an American-British tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 183, achieved on 15 September 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 316, achieved on 23 September 2024. He has won 13 ITF Men's World Tennis Tour titles from 27 finals.
